why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open the TastyCo quest app . The task list stays blurred behind "Connect wallet to unlock quests" until you connect a wallet.
Connect a wallet to sign in, create your profile and unlock the tasks.

Connect Telegram through the bot, then join Discord and follow TastyCo on X and Instagram. Warning Use the Discord invite in the footer of tastyco.io. Older invites in TastyCo's Telegram posts and link page are dead, which makes it easy for fake ones to circulate.
Take the weekly quiz and come back on consecutive days for the streak points.
Share your referral link if you want referral points.
Optional: complete the TaskOn campaign before 25 October 2026.
Wait for the token launch. No claim page exists yet.
costs: The quests are free as published. They are social tasks, a quiz and a wallet connection, with no deposit or purchase. Costs come later if you use the planned launchpad, which will need an identity check, staked $TASTY and a 0.85% fee on trades.
risks: The "live" market panel on the homepage isn't real trading. Its prices and orders are generated by a script on the page, with no data feed behind them and no label saying it is a demo. TastyCo says its contracts are audited by Hacken. Hacken's own report on the project says no public audit exists yet, because the token hasn't launched.
